name: Necklace of Adaptation
body: While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have advantage on saving throws made against harmful gases and vapors (such as _cloudkill_ and _stinking cloud_ effects, inhaled poisons, and the breath weapons of some dragons).
